language: JavaScript (Node.js 24) rule checks over Dockerfile, .dockerignore, compose.yaml and .gitignore files

failingTests: backend Dockerfile has a named JDK build stage and a JRE runtime stage
backend Dockerfile downloads dependencies with go-offline before copying src, then packages
backend runtime stage copies only the packaged jar from the build stage
backend runtime stage starts the jar it copied
compose.yaml defines the api service built from ./backend and a postgres:18 db service
compose.yaml keeps database data in a declared named volume
compose.yaml binds every published port to 127.0.0.1
both services get the database password from an existing local env file, never a literal
local env files are ignored by Git and not tracked
api datasource URL uses the db service name, container port and database name
db healthcheck runs pg_isready with the wired user and database, and api waits for service_healthy
backend .dockerignore leaves out build output, version control and secrets
frontend .dockerignore leaves out installed packages, build output, version control and secrets
frontend Dockerfile builds with Node and serves with nginx
frontend Dockerfile installs dependencies before copying the source
frontend nginx stage copies only the built dist folder

cleanup.notes: Delete tests/node_modules (created by npm ci) and starter/.env (your disposable local password file). The lab creates no database, image, container or volume: nothing runs a container engine.

licensing.item: starter/backend/mvnw, starter/backend/mvnw.cmd and starter/backend/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties, generated by org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-wrapper-plugin:3.3.4 (goal wrapper, -Dmaven=3.9.11 -Dtype=only-script) and committed unchanged
yaml 2.9.1, installed by npm ci from tests/package-lock.json, not committed
vite 7.3.6 and its dependencies, pinned in starter/frontend/package-lock.json and installed only inside the learner image build, not committed
